Subject: Re: Slideshow

Thanks Ziga

Just to let you know that you may suddenly get some new users of your  
Slideshow Script, as I have produced an implementation into a snippet  
for use with the Etomite Content Management System - see here:
http://www.etomite.com/forums/index.php?showtopic=6562

What the snippet does, is pull *all* the images from a set directory,  
and integrate them into the JS call (which pulls the JS file from  
your server, so the JS remains intact), with customization options  
within the snippet.

Regards,
Dean
Etomite.com Admin



On 15 Jan 2007, at 18:07, Ziga Mahkovec wrote:

> On Fri, 2007-01-12 at 01:37 +0000, Dean Clinton wrote:
>> Hi,
>
> Hi Dean,
>
>> I was wondering - with the Slideshow JS, is it possible to get the
>> slideshow to autoplay?
>
> There is currently no documented API for that.  But the following
> JavaScript code should work as intended:
>
>   var viewer = new PhotoViewer();
>   viewer.add("photo1.jpg");
>   ...
>   viewer.show(0);
>   viewer.setShowCallback(function() { viewer.slideShow(true);  
> viewer.setShowCallback(undefined); });
>
>
> We'll consider adding this to the official API.
>
>
> Regards,
> -- 
> Ziga
> TripTracker Team
>
